description: Details submitted pursuant to reference 25/02646/FUL: SuDS (15) in respect of erection of a pair semi-detached two storey dwellinghouses with accommodation in roof space and rear and front dormers.
decision_conditions: The details submitted are insufficient to secure the discharge of Condition 15 (Sustainable Drainage Strategy) attached to planning permission ref. 25/02646/FUL. The submitted drainage strategy fails to demonstrate that the proposed surface water discharge rates are acceptable or sufficiently aligned with greenfield runoff rates. As such, the Local Planning Authority is not satisfied that the proposed drainage arrangements would adequately manage surface water runoff and minimise flood risk. The submitted details therefore fail to meet the requirements of Condition 15 and are contrary to Policies DMD61 and DMD62 of the Enfield Development Management Document (2014), Core Policy 28 of the Enfield Core Strategy (2010), and Policies SI12 and SI13 of the London Plan (2021).
